mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months, it signals severe labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness that triggers equity market sentiment shifts, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline >0.5% in prior month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both decline >0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 95.0), manufacturing slowdown signals reduced capacity utilization and near-term earnings pressure, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When core CPI exceeds 2.5% year-over-year, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger premature monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payrolls above 100,000 signals robust labor market growth that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases >100,000, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During strong GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%), the economy enters a late-cycle expansion phase where stretched valuations outweigh earnings strength, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 90.0, it indicates severe manufacturing slowdown that typically precedes recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when INDPRO < 90.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
